feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence so far: moving the sensor row from y=0.04 to y=0.06 (iteration 2 to 3) cut oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87, so forward sensing helps the oval. Widening the outer pair to ±0.05 (iteration 4) cut oval progress to 0.80, pushed oval max_error back to 0.0607, and left s-bend and slalom max_error near 0.062, so outer spacing is not the bend-entry lever. Oscillation barely moved when the controller was softened (0.339 to 0.333), so it is not solved by damping alone. Line loss has stayed at 0.5 to 1.0 per run with 16 mm footprints. If the 12 mm race keeps oval progress near 0.87 and s-bend/slalom max_error falls below 0.06, keep 12 mm and treat the remaining work as turn authority. If line_loss_events rise above 1.0 on any track, return to 16 mm footprints. If oval progress drops while max_error stays under 0.06, the 16 mm footprint was helping and should be restored before any further geometry change.
requested_changes: If s-bend or slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 with line_loss_events at or below 1.0 after the 12 mm race: move the sensor row forward to y = 0.07 (keep x = ±0.04 and sensor_size 0.012). Evidence: moving the row from y=0.04 to y=0.06 in iterations 2 to 3 lowered oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87.

If the oval progress falls below 0.8 or line_loss_events rise above 1.0 on any track: return sensor_size to 0.016 and keep ±0.04 at y = 0.06. Evidence: 16 mm footprints gave progress 0.87 and line loss 0.9 on the oval in iteration 3, while widening to ±0.05 in iteration 4 cut progress to 0.80.

If oval progress holds at or above 0.87 but steering_oscillation stays above 0.3: try wheel_track 0.085 m with the rest unchanged. Evidence: narrowing wheel_track from 0.10 to 0.09 in iterations 1 to 2 raised oval progress from 0.46 to 0.53, though that change was confounded with body and controller changes.
